title: Two projects, different questions
lead: Explore the sensing objective and the design tools without confusing their evidence.
description: ArtiSense asks what a compact optical sensing system could measure. AIFIELD asks how photonic systems can be designed and simulated.

sections.title: ArtiSense
paragraphs: The proposed system combines illumination, optical response and interpretation. Glucose sensing is a substantial research example, but validated measurement remains ahead.

sections.title: AIFIELD
paragraphs: The September 2026 material describes photonic CAD, several simulation tasks and agent-assisted workflows with human review. Neural field prediction remains a separate research direction.

sections.title: A useful connection
paragraphs: AIFIELD can help explore sensing chip designs. A simulated design is not a tested sensor, and each project needs its own validation.
